tools.name: atlas_orient
tools.description:
Discover canonical identity from an ordinary-language query —
the entry point when no canonical id is held. Candidates carry id,
status, Hook, and disclosure class; results are paged. A miss is
a successful empty payload.

tools.name: atlas_cards
tools.description:
Read 1-4 canonical ids as one ordered Card per id: identity,
Hook, and sealed claims with source addresses. Atomic batch. Use
atlas_read for Section wording or a complete Node.

tools.name: atlas_read
tools.description:
Read a complete Node (bare id), one Section
('node-id#section-slug'), or one Decision record
('decision:<decision-id>'). A Card from atlas_cards is usually
cheaper than a whole Node.

tools.name: atlas_links
tools.description:
Page one subject's relationship occurrences, outbound then
inbound, each with direction, reference class, source Section, and
far-end identity and Hook. Use atlas_read for the full Node.

tools.name: atlas_provenance
tools.description:
Expand cited span addresses into audit facts: dependency
digest, attestations, and the Release's expanded identity. Atomic
batch; only for auditing how a claim is sourced.

tools.name: atlas_navigate
tools.description:
Read 'tree', the canonical ordered traversal of every published
node, or 'tour', the publisher-curated first learning path. Use
atlas_orient for relevance-ranked discovery.

tools.name: atlas_define
tools.description:
Define one admitted glossary term. 'match' states the outcome:
'exact' carries the definition, 'ambiguous' lists the narrowing
terms, 'none' is a successful miss.

tools.name: atlas_decisions
tools.description:
List or search the admitted Decision summaries — id, title,
Hook, in manifest order. Use atlas_read at 'decision:<id>' for the
complete record.
